strings.name: Siya Kolisi
strings.summary: Kolisi rose from Zwide township near Port Elizabeth to professional rugby. In 2018 he became South Africa's first Black Test captain and led consecutive World Cup victories in 2019 and 2023. His flanker play and public role made sport a focus for opportunity and social unity. After spells with the Stormers, Sharks and Racing 92, he returned to the Stormers in 2026.
